data.narrative:
Cellares is a Series C-stage biotech company that has raised $350M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 same-sector, same-stage private companies (Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit) and 3 public biotech comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L), supplemented by a broader universe of 8 private peers in the biotech sector.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. The stage-progression method, using $12M as a raised-capital proxy and applying a 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, implies a $20M valuation. The peer-median method, anchoring to the median valuation of three same-sector, same-stage private companies, yields $3.8B, with a range of $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiple cannot be applied; the sector median P/S is 6.6x across three public tickers, but Cellares' revenue is not on file. The stage-progression result appears an outlier given the capital deployed and peer context.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.7B to $4.4B, with a median point of $1.9B. This range is anchored primarily to peer private valuations. Key uncertainties include the magnitude of any subsequent funding, clinical or commercial inflection since the peer valuations were established, and revenue visibility relative to the public biotech cohort.
